text.en:
Section 8 of Presidential Decree No. 175 is hereby amended by adding the following paragraph
after sub-paragraph (j):
Any provisions of law to the contrary notwithstanding the Monetary Board of the Central Bank shall have
exclusive responsibility and authority over the banking functions and operations of cooperative banks.

This Decree shall take effect immediately.
DONE in the City of Manila, this 16th day of January, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and
seventy-eight.
